changes.title: Cooldown trail 2
items: Your whole trail is now dotted: the first band (as long as your speed makes it) is in your trail colours too, and each band behind it is a dodge still recharging. Only the first band left means every dodge, and taking off, is ready.
The trail now goes behind trees and scenery just as you do, and shows through with you where the canopy's cut away.
The trail's dots glow a little more, and the take-off ring is gone.

changes.title: Commanded feeding
items: Feeding is now up to you: no animal eats on its own. Stand within 15 m of a berry and tap the sigil button (E, square) to feed the animal at the bottom of your stack; each tap queues one more berry. The berry it'll go for is marked, with the prompt beside it
With a berry marked, hold the sigil button for a moment to put that animal's sigil down instead
A sigil in your stack twinkles the dot it's about to fill while it has a berry queued; babies now show their one berry dot
Knocked down, your animals' sigils fall where you went down and stay there: they wait for you there, parked, and guard the spot

changes.title: Notice dismiss
items: The note that a link opens a different night from your saved one now fades after 12 seconds, and every save note has a × to close it

changes.title: Sail bend
items: Sailing from the sea chart, the map's sea now fades into the island's own sea, the same blue, instead of into a black screen, and you see the sea, the beach and the forest the whole way in
Sailing in, the world curves away below the horizon and the great oak's crown rises over it as you fly in, instead of the camera swinging round to the tree
Pause page: three sliders for the dive's curve (how strong, how fast it grows, how fast it eases off)

changes.title: Fresh link
items: A new link, https://edsaperia.github.io/witch/?fresh=1, starts a brand-new game on the latest version every time, without touching your own saves.

changes.title: Cooldown trail
items: Your trail now shows your dodges: behind the usual glow come bands of glowing pixel dots, one band for each dodge still recharging, the dots vanishing one by one from the tail. Only the glow left means every dodge, and taking off, is ready.
With extra dodges (Twig bristles, Hare's Dash, the Double blink broom) the trail grows more bands, and where you could take off before it's empty a small ring marks the point it must drain to.
The bands are longer the faster you fly (over the treetops, with speed buffs), but each still drains in a dodge's time.
Choose your trail's colours at the Broom station: six presets, from warm 🟥🟧🟨⬜ to cool 🟪🟦🟩🟨, pastel, party, gold and ice.
